2026 Global tourism expected to grow 
amid geopolitical uncertainty
•UN Tourism reported global tourism surpassed pre -pandemic levels in 2024. Global tourist arrivals reached 1.5 bn in 2025 
(+4% YoY), surpassing 2019 levels, supported by strong demand, major source markets, Asia and the Pacific recovery, air 
connectivity, and visa facilitation. UN Tourism expects global tourism to grow 3 –4% in 2026 (as of 20 January 2026). 
•Thailand international arrivals reached 32.97 million in 2025, falling short of target amid weaker Chinese demand. TAT targets 
recovery to 36.7 million arrivals in 2026 (+11% YoY) and THB 3 trillion tourism revenue.
•Geopolitical uncertainties continued to affect travel costs and sentiment.
